review_note: At line 1216 given R=Γ(X,O_X) and R-module M, the globally associated quasi-coherent sheaf F_M base-changes to associated sheaf for Γ(Y,O_Y)⊗_R M under ANY morphism g:Y→X of ringed spaces. The prepared explicit sheafification description matches the named F_M.
statement:
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Set $R = \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$.
Let $M$ be an $R$-module.
Let $\mathcal{F}_M$ be the quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-module obtained by sheafifying the presheaf $V\mapsto\mathcal{O}_X(V)\otimes_R M$ on the opens $V\subseteq X$.
If $g : (Y, \mathcal{O}_Y) \to (X, \mathcal{O}_X)$
is a morphism of ringed spaces, then
$g^*\mathcal{F}_M$ is the sheaf associated
to the $\Gamma(Y, \mathcal{O}_Y)$-module
$\Gamma(Y, \mathcal{O}_Y) \otimes_R M$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-restrict-quasi-coherent}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Set $R = \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$.
Let $M$ be an $R$-module.
Let $\mathcal{F}_M$ be the quasi-coherent sheaf of
$\mathcal{O}_X$-modules associated to $M$.
If $g : (Y, \mathcal{O}_Y) \to (X, \mathcal{O}_X)$
is a morphism of ringed spaces, then
$g^*\mathcal{F}_M$ is the sheaf associated
to the $\Gamma(Y, \mathcal{O}_Y)$-module
$\Gamma(Y, \mathcal{O}_Y) \otimes_R M$.

review_note: At line 1246 if x has a FUNDAMENTAL SYSTEM of quasi-compact neighborhoods, any quasi-coherent O_X-module F becomes an associated sheaf F_M on SOME open neighborhood U of x. Draft preserves this unusual topological hypothesis and local conclusion.
statement:
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Let $x \in X$ be a point.
Assume that $x$ has a fundamental system of quasi-compact neighbourhoods.
Consider any quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-module $\mathcal{F}$.
For an open $U\subseteq X$ and an $\Gamma(U,\mathcal{O}_U)$-module $M$, denote by $\mathcal{F}_M$ the sheafification of $V\mapsto\mathcal{O}_U(V)\otimes_{\Gamma(U,\mathcal{O}_U)}M$ on $U$.
Then there exists an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$
such that $\mathcal{F}|_U$ is isomorphic to the
sheaf of modules $\mathcal{F}_M$ on $(U, \mathcal{O}_U)$
associated to some $\Gamma(U, \mathcal{O}_U)$-module $M$.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-quasi-coherent-module}
Let $(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be a ringed space.
Let $x \in X$ be a point.
Assume that $x$ has a fundamental system of quasi-compact neighbourhoods.
Consider any quasi-coherent $\mathcal{O}_X$-module $\mathcal{F}$.
Then there exists an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$
such that $\mathcal{F}|_U$ is isomorphic to the
sheaf of modules $\mathcal{F}_M$ on $(U, \mathcal{O}_U)$
associated to some $\Gamma(U, \mathcal{O}_U)$-module $M$.
